overview_description.description: My Family Book is an operator of a social database that stores and shares family photos, videos, and memories. The company's platform offers a common account that can be created by a family member, and which the member can share and invite other family members to participate in, and which can be accessed anywhere from anywhere at any time. By doing so, people can share, receive, and share memories, photos, and experiences with their families.
